messages.subject: blavaan 0.4-7
parts: blavaan 0.4-7 is now on CRAN. The main update to this version is different compiler settings, which CRAN requested (and added a deadline for me to make the change). But I also managed to fix the bugs from 0.4-6 that involved meanstructure. (missing lvs, problems with fit indices)
